en.headline: Hong Kong Palace Museum stages one-night Egypt after-hours event on Wednesday
en.dek: A Pharaoh’s Rendezvous offers exclusive evening access to the Ancient Egypt Unveiled exhibition plus guided tours, performances and themed food on 19 August.
body: The Hong Kong Palace Museum will hold a one-night-only after-hours programme titled A Pharaoh’s Rendezvous on Wednesday 19 August to mark the final month of its landmark Ancient Egypt Unveiled exhibition.

The organisers said the evening includes exclusive access to Gallery 9 housing the main display of 250 treasures, guided docent tours of thematic displays in Galleries 3 and 4, a panel discussion, live folk dance, curated music and DJ sets. Attendees can also sample Egyptian snacks, drinks blending Chinese and Egyptian flavours, experience ancient scents and take photographs at themed setups against the Victoria Harbour skyline.

Tickets are priced at HK$450 and include entry to the participating galleries, all event activities and a complimentary ancient Egypt-inspired blind-box bag charm. The exhibition itself continues until 31 August.

zh.headline: 故宮博物館周三晚辦古埃及展特別夜間活動
zh.dek: 「法老之約」提供展覽獨家晚間入場、導賞、表演及主題飲食，門票450元，展期至8月31日。
body: 香港故宮文化博物館將於8月19日（星期三）晚舉行一夜限定的「法老之約」特別活動，紀念大型展覽「古埃及文明大展」進入最後一個月。
主辦方表示，當晚包括獨家進入展出250件珍品的9號展廳，以及3號及4號展廳的主題展品導賞，另設專題對談、民間舞蹈表演、音樂及DJ環節。參加者亦可品嚐埃及小吃、中埃風味飲品、體驗古代香氛，並在維港景色下於主題佈景拍照。
門票售價450港元，包括相關展廳入場、所有活動及一份古埃及主題盲盒袋飾。展覽本身將繼續至8月31日。
